title: Select a Harvester
desktop: Left-click a Harvester near your Command core.
touch: Tap a Harvester near your Command core.

title: Move to the marker
desktop: With a Harvester selected, right-click the yellow marker.
touch: Select a Harvester, choose Move, then tap the yellow marker.

title: Gather 10 alloy
desktop: Select a Harvester and right-click amber crystals. Cargo returns automatically.
touch: Select a Harvester, then tap amber crystals. Cargo returns automatically.

title: Build a Supply relay
desktop: Select a Harvester, choose Supply relay, then click a clear site. Wait for completion.
touch: Select a Harvester, choose Supply relay, tap a clear site, then confirm placement.

title: Train a Ranger
desktop: Select Barracks and click Ranger. Wait for the production queue to finish.
touch: Tap Barracks, choose Ranger and wait for the production queue to finish.

title: Attack the practice target
desktop: Select soldiers and right-click the marked target. Land a hit; it cannot fire back.
touch: Select soldiers, choose Attack, then tap the marked target. It cannot fire back.

title: Withdraw with Move
desktop: Select a soldier fighting the target. Press M, then click the yellow marker to withdraw.
touch: Select a soldier fighting the target. Choose Move and tap the yellow marker to withdraw.

title: Finish the target
desktop: The target is weakened. Select your soldiers and right-click it to finish training.
touch: The target is weakened. Select soldiers, choose Attack and tap it to finish training.
